description: Header file declaring functions for converting numerical values to strings (xtoa, ultoa, itoa). It provides prototypes for these conversion functions and is part of the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform.

methods.name: xtoa
methods.description: Converts an unsigned long value to string representation in specified base, handling negative sign if needed.

methods.name: ultoa
methods.description: Converts an unsigned long value to string representation in specified base.

methods.name: itoa
methods.description: Converts an integer value to string representation in specified base.
